slides.title: Wait before you hit *send*.
slides.sub: Twenty minutes. Then read it out loud.

slides.title: Write it. Don't send it.
slides.body: When a message is hot, get it all out. Type every word. Then leave it sitting in drafts.

slides.title: Wait twenty minutes.
slides.body: Walk, breathe, do something else. Let the heat drop before you decide what goes out.

slides.title: Read it out loud.
slides.body: Hear it the way they will. Would you say this to their face, in this tone? What would you cut?

slides.title: Try it this week.
slides.body: Next hot message: save it as a draft, set a timer, read it aloud before it goes. Notice what you changed.
